parsed.basis: Norway has no offence targeting transgender people, prohibits discrimination on gender identity and expression, and records bias-motivated offences under its hate-crime framework, while reported anti-LGBTQ hate crimes rose in 2023 and clearance fell, with low reporting attributed to mistrust. Legal gender recognition is by self-declaration, but gender-affirming care remains narrowly channelled through specialist assessment in Oslo. In Trøndelag, Trondheim is a large university and student city with generally liberal social attitudes and the same national police, health and anti-discrimination systems as elsewhere; more rural districts may be socially more traditional, but there are no distinct local rules or documented pattern of targeted enforcement against transgender visitors.
